prose: Basis: the Techmeme summary of the report; the Portland Business Journal article could not be fetched. Workday has agreed to acquire C1.ai, the company formerly known as ConductorOne, which builds enterprise software for managing both human and AI agent identities and has raised $111M to date.
The deal extends Workday's push into identity governance at a moment when enterprises are starting to treat AI agents as identities that need the same lifecycle management as employees.
highlights: Workday agrees to acquire C1.ai, formerly ConductorOne
C1.ai manages human and AI agent identities for enterprises
